table.name: singer
table.purpose: One row per person (8 rows). Despite the table name 'singer', the data does not look like singers: the names are well-known billionaires (Christy Walton, Alice Walton, Gina Rinehart, Iris Fontbona, Susanne Klatten, Jacqueline Mars, Abigail Johnson) with citizenships and net worths. The table most plausibly catalogs wealthy individuals, and is referenced by the 'song' table via Singer_ID. The 'singer' naming is likely a mislabel or the dataset repurposed; the evidence does not support that these people are singers.

Birth_Year.name: Birth_Year
Birth_Year.description: Year of birth of the person, 1940-1962, stored as a number. Not unique; one value per row.

Citizenship.name: Citizenship
Citizenship.description: Country of citizenship of the person (e.g., United States, Australia, Chile, France, Germany).

Name.name: Name
Name.description: Full name of the person; unique across the 8 rows. The values are names of famous billionaires, which conflicts with the table name 'singer'.

Net_Worth_Millions.name: Net_Worth_Millions
Net_Worth_Millions.description: Net worth of the person in millions (range 12.7 to 30.0). Unit is ambiguous: the column name says millions, but the values (12.7-30.0) are far too small for these billionaires' actual net worths in millions of dollars; they may actually be in billions, or the values may be synthetic. The column records the person's net worth in the stated unit.

Singer_ID.name: Singer_ID
Singer_ID.description: Primary key of the table; unique integer 1-8 identifying each person. Referenced by song.Singer_ID (many songs to one person).

table.name: song
table.purpose: A catalog of songs, each with its title, performing singer, sales figures, and highest chart position reached (likely UK singles chart, given the titles).

Highest_Position.name: highest_chart_position
Highest_Position.description: The highest (best) chart position the song reached; 1 means it hit number one. Most songs here reached #1, one reached #3.

Sales.name: sales
Sales.description: Total sales/copies sold of the song, in units (e.g. 1,094,000 copies). All values are whole numbers stored as double.

Singer_ID.name: singer_id
Singer_ID.description: Foreign key to singer.Singer_ID identifying the performing singer of the song.

Song_ID.name: song_id
Song_ID.description: Primary key of the song table; unique identifier for each song.

Title.name: title
Title.description: The song's title (e.g. 'Cha Cha Slide', 'Do They Know It's Christmas').
